title: PH REIT facts extracted from one filing
description: Contract between extraction and analysis. Values are whole pesos (except per-share and percentages), signed as presented in the statements. Every fact cites the printed page it came from. Q2 and Q3 17-Q filings report cash flows year-to-date only, so they are analyzed on a year-to-date basis (period_type half or nine_months) using the year-to-date columns throughout.

page_basis.description: How page numbers are counted: starts with 'printed' (the number printed on the page, when it equals the PDF position throughout, as in most 17-Qs) or 'pdf_index' (the page's position in the PDF; required for 17-As, whose printed numbering restarts). index_pages.py suggests which.

document_map.description: Page ranges of the documents bundled in the PDF.

fair_value_change.description: Signed. Loss is negative. Required for fair_value model.

gain_on_property_sale.description: Gain (positive) or loss (negative) on disposal of investment property. Removed from FFO under both accounting models.

fair_value_appraisal_gain.description: Annual reports: the appraisal part of the net fair value change (e.g. 'Fair value adjustment' in the investment properties note). Signed.

fair_value_straight_line_offset.description: Annual reports: the straight-line adjustment netted inside the fair value change. Signed as printed (usually negative).

fair_value_lease_commissions.description: Annual reports: lease commissions netted inside the fair value change. Signed as printed (usually negative).

depreciation_amortization.description: Total D&A from the cash flow (may include non-real-estate items).

straight_line_rent_adjustment.description: Positive amount deducted for non-cash straight-line rent.

capex_investment_property.description: Positive amount paid for additions to investment properties.

capex_acquisitions.description: Cash purchases of whole properties that the filing identifies and that are included in capex_investment_property (e.g. a building bought for cash). Excluded from AFFO's capex: buying a building isn't upkeep. Positive amount.

change_due_from_related_parties.description: Investing cash flow line; negative = cash lent to related parties.

finance_lease_receivable_fair_value.description: Disclosed fair value of finance lease receivables (fair value measurement note, annual reports). Used for the fair-value-adjusted NAV; never estimate it.

investment_property_carrying.description: Cost model: carrying amount of investment property.

investment_property_fair_value.description: Cost model: disclosed fair value of investment property (PAS 40 disclosure).

appraisal_discount_rate_min.description: Annual reports: lowest discount rate the appraiser used, in percent (fair value note). Context only.

appraisal_discount_rate_max.description: Annual reports: highest discount rate the appraiser used, in percent. Context only.

interest_expense.description: Interest expense and other charges (income statement).

interest_income.description: Interest income other than finance lease interest (income statement).

reported_interest_coverage.description: Interest coverage ratio as reported (financial soundness indicators). Cross-check.

shares_outstanding_prior.description: Shares outstanding at the start of the period (prior year-end column). Used to flag shares issued during the period.

dividend_per_share_declared.description: Dividend declared FOR this period (may be declared after period end). Use the dividends list instead when the period has more than one declaration.

dividend_declared_total_reported.description: Reported peso total of the dividends declared for the period (one declaration, or the period's total when there is a dividends list).

reported_payout_pct.description: The company's own payout of distributable income, in percent (annual reports). Cross-check.

retained_earnings_available_for_dividend.description: Annual reports: total retained earnings available for dividend declaration at year-end (supplementary schedule).

net_income_quarter.description: Year-to-date filings only: net income for the latest quarter as printed in the filing's quarter column. Cross-checks the derived quarter.

fair_value_change_quarter.description: Year-to-date filings only: fair value change for the latest quarter as printed. Cross-checks the derived quarter.

reported_nav_per_share.description: NAV per share as reported by the company. Cross-check, and the basis for price / NAV.

reported_nav_per_share_prior.description: Reported NAV per share at the prior year-end. Compared with issue prices of shares issued during the period.

market_price_close.description: Closing share price for the latest quarter from the filing's market information table.

available_credit_line.description: Unused credit lines available at period end, as disclosed.

history.description: Annual reports: earlier years from the comparative columns (income statement and cash flows show three years, the balance sheet two), for a trend. One entry per year; the current year comes from the main facts.

facts.description: Any of: net_income, fair_value_change, gain_on_property_sale, straight_line_rent_adjustment, capex_investment_property, operating_cash_flow, reported_distributable_income, dividend_declared_total_reported (dividends declared for that year), reported_payout_pct, total_equity, shares_outstanding.

trailing_dividends.description: Dividend per share declared for each of the last four quarters up to and including the latest quarter, for the trailing yield.

share_issuances.description: Rows of the share issuance (property-for-share swap) table, including comparative-year rows.

nav_before.description: Latest reported NAV per share before the issuance that this filing discloses.

share_issuance_totals.description: The printed totals row of the share issuance table, one entry per year. Used to tell a typo in one row from an error in the whole table.

subsequent_events.description: Events after the reporting date, or transactions still pending at period end, that affect shares, debt or dividends.

dividends.description: Every dividend declared FOR this period, one entry per declaration, each with the share count on its record date. Use when the period covers more than one quarter (e.g. Q1 and Q2 dividends in a half-year review). Either this or facts.dividend_per_share_declared is required; this takes precedence.

shares.description: Shares outstanding on the record date.

reported_total.description: Peso total as reported by the company.

pdf_page.description: PDF page index if it differs from the printed page.

label.description: Exact text printed on the cited page (line item name or a short phrase next to the value), so a reader can search the PDF for it. Context goes in column or note, not here. scripts/check_citations.py verifies it.

column.description: Column header the value sits under, e.g. 'January 1 to June 30, 2026' or 'December 31, 2025'.

citation.description: 'visual' when the page has no text layer and the value was read from the page image. check_citations.py can't verify it, so confidence must be medium or low.

rounded.description: True if the filing reported this rounded (in millions unless unit says otherwise) and it was converted to pesos.

unit.description: Unit the rounded figure was printed in.

also_reported.description: Other places the filing prints the same figure. Each is citation-checked, and compute_metrics.py reports any that disagree as a likely inconsistency in the filing.
